d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi 21 navanbar ko bihar daure par aa rahe hain. is dauran ve kachchi dargah-bidupur chhah len pul yani ‘nitish setu’ ka udghatan karenge. siem samrat chaudhri ne piem modi ke daure aur pul ke udghatan ko lekar bara ailan kiya hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
